# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]

Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

## La SNCF sur les routes du Tour de France !

Fournisseur officiel de la plus grande course cycliste au monde, la SNCF vibre au rythme des
exploits des coureurs et de la ferveur des millions de spectateurs massés le long du parcours de la
Grande Boucle.

[En savoir plus][8]

## Découvrez notre actualité

### Fortes chaleurs : quelles conséquences ?

Découvrez leurs impacts sur les infrastructures ferroviaires et nos mesures pour assurer votre
sécurité.

[En savoir plus][9]

### On se retrouve aux Journées européennes du patrimoine !

Nous organisons 160 événements, du 18 au 20 septembre partout France, pour célébrer le patrimoine
ferroviaire.

[En savoir plus][10]

### Les coulisses du métier de chef de bord

À rebours des clichés qui circulent sur les « contrôleurs », partez à la rencontre de trois d'entre
eux.

[En savoir plus][11]

### L’étude qui bouleverse les idées reçues sur les transports

À l’occasion de ses 20 ans, Keoscopie, l’observatoire des modes de vie et des mobilités de Keolis,
dresse un panorama des habitudes de déplacement des Français.

[En savoir plus][12]

# Groupe SNCF

[Groupe SNCF][Groupe SNCF]][6]
* Découvrir le Groupe
* Agir pour la mobilité
* Défendre un monde durable
* Inventer l'avenir
* [#EnCoulisses][7]

## La SNCF sur les routes du Tour de France !

Fournisseur officiel de la plus grande course cycliste au monde, la SNCF vibre au rythme des
exploits des coureurs et de la ferveur des millions de spectateurs massés le long du parcours de la
Grande Boucle.

[En savoir plus][8]

## Découvrez notre actualité

### Fortes chaleurs : quelles conséquences ?

Découvrez leurs impacts sur les infrastructures ferroviaires et nos mesures pour assurer votre
sécurité.

[En savoir plus][9]

### On se retrouve aux Journées européennes du patrimoine !

Nous organisons 160 événements, du 18 au 20 septembre partout France, pour célébrer le patrimoine
ferroviaire.

[En savoir plus][10]

### Les coulisses du métier de chef de bord

À rebours des clichés qui circulent sur les « contrôleurs », partez à la rencontre de trois d'entre
eux.

[En savoir plus][11]

### L’étude qui bouleverse les idées reçues sur les transports

À l’occasion de ses 20 ans, Keoscopie, l’observatoire des modes de vie et des mobilités de Keolis,
dresse un panorama des habitudes de déplacement des Français.

[En savoir plus][12]

## Notre Groupe en quelques chiffres
* [TGV INOUI sur le quai d'une gare]
  
  On transporte
  
  15 M
  
  de passagers chaque jour dans le monde
* On a réalisé
  
  43 Mds€
  
  de chiffre d’affaires en 2025
  
  [Consultez nos actualités financières][13]
* [Train et panneaux solaires]
  
  On vise
  
  -30%
  
  d’émissions de gaz à effet de serre sur nos activités de transport en 2030 (vs 2015)
  
  [En savoir plus sur notre stratégie RSE][14]

### Notre présence dans le monde

Le saviez-vous ? Nous opérons des bus au Danemark et du métro en Inde, nous convoyons des
marchandises en avion depuis la Chine vers le Mexique et construisons des tours en Chine...
Découvrez nos 1001 projets, dans 120 pays dans le monde.

[En savoir plus][15]

# Revolutionize the way the world moves for future generations

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added
services. Whether it's freight rail, transit, mining, industrial or marine, our expertise,
technologies, and people - together - are accelerating the future of transportation.

[ Vision, Mission, & Values ][133]
[ Sustainability at Wabtec ][134]
[Inspiring the Next Generation of Innovators]

## Inspiring the Next Generation of Innovators

For 14 years, Wabtec Girls Camp has inspired young girls to explore STEM through hands-on
challenges, mentorship from Wabtec engineers, and experiences that build confidence, spark
curiosity, and expand future opportunities.

[ Learn more ][135]
[Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future]

## Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future

As Europe's freight rail industry advances toward a more connected future, digital technologies are
creating new opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, and reliability. Daniel Gradl, President
of Brakes & Couplers at Wabtec explores how telematics, Digital Automatic Couplers (DAC),
intelligent yard operations, and industry collaboration are helping drive this transformation.

[ Read the Story ][136]
[Breathing Easier on Paris' RER A]

## Improved Air Quality for the Paris RER A line

On the RER A, the busiest line in the Paris region, RATP is taking steps to improve air quality with
Green Friction. Developed by Wabtec, this innovative braking solution helps significantly reduce
particulate emissions, making a real difference in underground and closed environments where it
matters most.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added

challenges, mentorship from Wabtec engineers, and experiences that build confidence, spark
curiosity, and expand future opportunities.

## Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future

As Europe's freight rail industry advances toward a more connected future, digital technologies are
creating new opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, and reliability. Daniel Gradl, President
of Brakes & Couplers at Wabtec explores how telematics, Digital Automatic Couplers (DAC),
intelligent yard operations, and industry collaboration are helping drive this transformation.

## Improved Air Quality for the Paris RER A line

On the RER A, the busiest line in the Paris region, RATP is taking steps to improve air quality with
Green Friction. Developed by Wabtec, this innovative braking solution helps significantly reduce
particulate emissions, making a real difference in underground and closed environments where it
matters most.

large-scale infrastructure and construction projects. Designed for safety and durability, they meet

electrical, pump, and agricultural sectors. Our precision-engineered parts support seamless assembly
and consistent product performance.

railways and public utilities. They ensure reliability, safety, and efficiency in critical
infrastructure networks.

# Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer custom manufacturing based on drawings or samples?
Yes, we specialize in custom-engineered components. Share your drawing or sample, and we’ll develop
a tailored solution.
What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
MOQ starts from 100 pieces, depending on the product type. Custom bulk orders are also accepted.
Are your products certified and export-compliant?
Absolutely. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified, MSME registered, and CE compliance is in progress. Our
products meet global standards.

# CLERPREM – OEM MANUFACTURER - AUTOMOTIVE INTERIOR COMPONENTS AND RAILWAY SEATING SYSTEMS

Clerprem is an international group with over 50 years of experience in the design and manufacture of
seating systems and interior components for mobility. Headquartered in Northern Italy and with
plants across several continents, it serves the automotive and railway sectors, pairing a
tailor-made approach — rooted in the Italian manufacturing tradition — with the world’s leading OEMs
and operators. Design, engineering and innovation come together in highly modular products,
developed to the highest standards of quality, comfort and safety. A family business with a global
vision, driven by the values of Made in Italy and a concrete commitment to sustainability and the
future of mobility.

### DESIGN

We portray and convey customer’s ideas and requirements by designing innovative passengers’ seats
and their components with an Italian taste

### MANUFACTURING

Our expert teams die-cast, weld and powder coat frames, trim covers, foam and upholster cushions for
product final assembly with the latest technologies

### QUALITY

Our quality specialists monitor throughout the entire manufacturing processes the compliance with
aesthetic, comfort and safety standards

"WE CREATE ADDED VALUE FOR OUR CUSTOMERS MANUFACTURING PREMIUM QUALITY PRODUCTS"

##### CORE VALUES

We believe and encourage employees personal development, equal opportunities, environmental and
social sustainability and authentic business ethics

###### VISION

We aim to be The trusted leader in premium seating solutions through constant innovation, quality
and commitment; we strive to redefine comfort and reliability in transportation

##### MISSION

We deliver premium seating solutions designed to meet the highest standards of the Automotive and
Railway industries; with a focus on innovation, quality, and passenger well-being

### AUTOMOTIVE COMPONENTS

Made in Italy]
[Clerprem OEM automotive seat upholstery and trim cover, premium materials, custom finishes]
[Clerprem automotive interior design detail, Italian manufacturer for premium vehicle seating]

### RAILWAY SEATING SYSTEMS

[Clerprem premium railway seat for high-speed and long-distance trains, ergonomic Italian design]
[Clerprem fully integrated OEM railway seating system for intercity trains, customizable and
durable]

## A Leading OEM Seat Manufacturer for Railway & Automotive

Clerprem is a Tier-1 OEM manufacturer of lightweight, modular seating systems and interior
components for the railway and automotive industries. With over 50 years of Made-in-Italy
engineering and plants across Europe, North Africa and the Americas, Clerprem partners with the
world’s leading OEMs and operators — including VW Group, Ferrari, Mercedes, BMW, or Bombardier,
Siemens, Alstom, Deutsch Bhan, Stadler  — to deliver seats built to the highest standards of
comfort, durability and safety, in compliance with EN 45545-2.

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

[Dinghan Germany - Ihr Partner für Leistungselektronik von Schienenfahrzeugen]



[ mehr » ][28]





Unternehmen

SMART Railway – dieser Name steht für jahrzehntelange Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet hocheffizienter
Bordnetzumrichter für den Schienenverkehr. Die Geschichte des heute zur Dinghan Group gehörenden
Unternehmens weist eine kontinuierliche Entwicklung zuverlässiger und auf die Anforderungen der
Bahntechnik zugeschnittener Produkte auf. Seit mehr als 30 Jahren entwickelt und fertigt das in
Kassel ansässige Unternehmen leistungselektronische Lösungen.



[ mehr » ][29]





Wir als Arbeitgeber

Unsere Ideen fahren durch die Welt: Mehr als 10.000 Schienenfahrzeuge fahren bereits mit Systemen
der SMART Railway Technology GmbH, dem weltweiten Technologieführer und größten Hersteller für
Bordnetzumrichter. Mit Leidenschaft, Begeisterung und Visionskraft entwickeln wir anspruchsvolle
Leistungselektronik für den globalen Schienenverkehr. Als erfolgreiches Tochterunternehmen eines
großen internationalen Konzerns bieten wir unseren mehr als 160 Mitarbeitern jede Menge
Gestaltungsfreiraum und beste Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem interkulturellen und
partnerschaftlichen Umfeld. Gemeinsam bewegen wir viel und verändern den Markt – in einer Branche,
die nach vorne schaut.

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

Unternehmen

SMART Railway – dieser Name steht für jahrzehntelange Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet hocheffizienter
Bordnetzumrichter für den Schienenverkehr. Die Geschichte des heute zur Dinghan Group gehörenden
Unternehmens weist eine kontinuierliche Entwicklung zuverlässiger und auf die Anforderungen der
Bahntechnik zugeschnittener Produkte auf. Seit mehr als 30 Jahren entwickelt und fertigt das in
Kassel ansässige Unternehmen leistungselektronische Lösungen.

### [ 12 juli - Pendelritjes met PCC tram voor 100j Van Beverenplein ][14]

Zoals te lezen in onze meest recente Actua, is het in het weekend van 11 en 12 juli 100 jaar geleden
dat de tramlijn werd verlengd vanaf de De Smetbrug tot het Van Beverenplein.

Om dat jubileum en ons tramerfgoed een beetje extra in de kijker te zetten, worden er op zondag 12
juli pendelritjes gereden tussen de haltes Van Beverenplein en Wittekaproenenplein. Dit met de
historische PCC 25 van de voormalige MIVG.

Deze ritten zullen plaatsvinden tussen 12u en 15u, met een frequentie van circa 30 minuten.
Op- en afstappen kan aan het Van Beverenplein en het Wittekaproenenplein, maar ook aan de
tussenliggende haltes. Geef een duidelijk signaal aan de bestuurder dat je mee wilt rijden en de
deuren worden geopend.

In samenwerking met VVM De Lijn en met steun van Stad Gent worden deze ritten gratis aangeboden.

 

[Foto PCC 25 - Collectie Michel Reps]
PCC 25 aan het Griendenplein - Foto Collectie Michel Reps.

### [ 100 jaar tram naar het Van Beverenplein ][16]

Op 11 juli 2026 is het precies 100 jaar geleden dat de tram verlengd werd van de De Smetbrug naar
het Van Beverenplein.

Het Van Beverenplein in Gent. Voor veel Gentenaars (en anderen) klinkt het bekend. Niet omdat er
zoveel bijzonders gebeurt, maar omdat het decennialang een eindbestemming was voor de tram.

De geschiedenis van deze eindhalte is ter gelegenheid van dit jubileum dan ook uitgeschreven in een
nieuwe "Actua", namelijk Actua 64 met als toepasselijke titel "100 jaar tram naar het Van
Beverenplein: wat een geschiedenis!"

De actua is te raadplegen door op de preview hieronder te klikken, of via de ["Publicaties"
pagina.][17]

[[Actua 64]][18]

### [ Prettige Feestdagen! ][20]

Het is de periode van Wensen, Hoop, en Vooruitzichten richting 2026. 🎄En naast de traditionele
kerstboodschap, hebben we ook goed nieuws, een van onze wensen voor 2026 is nu reeds vervuld
geraakt. Weliswaar niet door de Kerstman, maar door positief denken en inzetten op samenwerking met
onze koepel organisatie META Vzw en VVM De Lijn.🥳

Op de valreep nog in 2025, (maar nèt iets te laat voor de Kersttram) zijn PCC 25 en PCC 6208 (ons
dienstvoertuig) de afgelopen maand (na de nodige aanpassingen en technische correcties) succesvol
door een serie keuringen, remtesten, en inspecties geraakt, en hebben we vorige week een
keuringsattest voor 6 maanden mogen in ontvangst nemen.🍾🥂

❓Waarom 6 maanden en maar twee trams?: Omdat achter de schermen we nog steeds samen met Meta Vzw en
De Lijn hard aan het samenwerken zijn om het hele kader rond ritten met tram-erfgoed te hertekenen,
op alle vlakken èn voor allè verenigingen op de drie Vlaamse tramnetten! Onze ervaringen met de
keuring van deze twee "youngtimers" helpen mee dit proces & kader verder uit te werken voor andere &
oudere rijtuigen. 👍🥂

(En samen met de voertuigen van onze collega-verenigingen en onze 3 andere trams, gaan de 6208 en 25
ook terug mee dat proces in!)

### [ Prettige Feestdagen! ][20]

Het is de periode van Wensen, Hoop, en Vooruitzichten richting 2026. 🎄En naast de traditionele
kerstboodschap, hebben we ook goed nieuws, een van onze wensen voor 2026 is nu reeds vervuld
geraakt. Weliswaar niet door de Kerstman, maar door positief denken en inzetten op samenwerking met
onze koepel organisatie META Vzw en VVM De Lijn.🥳

Op de valreep nog in 2025, (maar nèt iets te laat voor de Kersttram) zijn PCC 25 en PCC 6208 (ons
dienstvoertuig) de afgelopen maand (na de nodige aanpassingen en technische correcties) succesvol
door een serie keuringen, remtesten, en inspecties geraakt, en hebben we vorige week een
keuringsattest voor 6 maanden mogen in ontvangst nemen.🍾🥂

❓Waarom 6 maanden en maar twee trams?: Omdat achter de schermen we nog steeds samen met Meta Vzw en
De Lijn hard aan het samenwerken zijn om het hele kader rond ritten met tram-erfgoed te hertekenen,
op alle vlakken èn voor allè verenigingen op de drie Vlaamse tramnetten! Onze ervaringen met de
keuring van deze twee "youngtimers" helpen mee dit proces & kader verder uit te werken voor andere &
oudere rijtuigen. 👍🥂

(En samen met de voertuigen van onze collega-verenigingen en onze 3 andere trams, gaan de 6208 en 25
ook terug mee dat proces in!)

Conclusie? Positiviteit, samenwerken en vooruitdenken opent deuren, creëert mogelijkheden en
opportuniteiten, en mooie vooruitzichten voor iedereen! 🥂

## What is the Japan Rail Pass?

The Japan Rail Pass (JR Pass) is a single ticket that gives you **unlimited train travel.**

It is widely regarded as the **best and easiest way** to travel around Japan by train, saving you
money with affordable prices.

The JR Pass is exclusively available to visitors to Japan from overseas and covers journeys across
all of Japan train network. It includes the famous **[Shinkansen bullet trains][48]**, airport
transfers, and even buses and certain ferries.

You can choose from 3 types of JR Pass: **7, 14 or 21 days**. You can also get a [Green Pass][49] to
upgrade to first class.

### Can I buy the Japan Rail Pass in Japan?

No, you cannot purchase the JR Pass in Japan.** You must order it online** and then collect it from

The exact time **will depend on your location,** but you’ll likely receive your order within 48
hours if you live in the US, UK, Canada, or Europe.

If you live in an isolated area of a large country, such as parts of Australia and Brazil, it may
take longer. However, it is **unlikely to take longer than 96 hours/4 business days.**

More information in our FAQ
**[How to make seat reservations?][61]**

### What is included in the Japan Rail Pass?

The Japan Rail Pass is valid on:
* Shinkansen high-speed trains
* JR Express and local trains
* JR Local buses
* Airport transfer trains to Tokyo and Osaka international airports

## FAQ

[

### Who is Kontron?

][50]

Kontron is a leading IoT/ Embedded Computer Technology (ECT) company that delivers intelligent
hardware, software, and system solutions across multiple industries. For more than 20 years, Kontron
has helped customers achieve their business goals with technologies for industrial automation,
transportation, communications, healthcare, and energy.

[

### Which industries does Kontron serve?

][51]

Kontron serves a wide range of mission critical industries, including the industrial automation,
transportation, defense and aerospace, energy and utilities, telecommunications and connectivity,
healthcare, and automotive sectors. Across these industries, Kontron provides secure and reliable
embedded and IoT solutions designed for long lifecycles and regulated environments.

[

### How can companies become CRA-compliant with Kontron?

][52]

Kontron supports customers in achieving compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) by
delivering secure‑by‑design embedded and edge systems today. This includes risk analysis, long‑term
software maintenance, vulnerability management, secure update mechanisms, and compliance‑ready
development processes aligned with standards such as IEC 62443. Kontron supports the entire product
lifecycle, ensuring long-term availability, and simplifying secure operations

[

### What makes Kontron’s IoT approach different?

][53]

Kontron delivers an integrated industrial IoT software‑first stack that combines secure embedded
hardware with KontronOS, device and fleet management, and cybersecurity solutions. This
software‑centric approach enables long‑term lifecycle management, secure updates, regulatory
readiness, and reliable operation of connected systems - from edge devices to enterprise and cloud
environments.

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# The Railway Consultancy

The Railway Consultancy provides consultancy services, both nationally and internationally, in the
fields of railway planning, operations, economics, management, strategy and training. Our [areas of
expertise][54] cover both operational and demand planning, and work is carried out for a range of
clients, both in the UK and overseas.

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

On other pages you can find details of our experience gained across a wide range of [rail planning
projects][55], some of them using our in-house [GCOST™][56] and [Trakattk™][57] models.

[Crystal Palace]

We have worked for many train operators, including Southern. Pictured here are two Southern trains
passing underneath our previous office at Crystal Palace Station.

The Railway Consultancy is involved in activities across the major fields of commercial and
operational planning for railways, including metro, suburban, inter-city passenger, and freight.
Projects we have worked are organised under the following headings:
* [Feasibility Studies][58]
* [Commercial Planning][59]
* [Operational Planning][60]
* [Management & Strategy][61]
* [Audit & Assessment][62]
* [Analysis, Research & Training][63]

Already delivered and in service:
* Liverpool South Parkway Station
* Class 455 redesign
* Revised timetable allowances to improve punctuality on SWR, Southern, LNER and in Norway
* HS2 service specification improved to benefit Stoke-on-Trent

[The Railway Consultancy]

Our [ethos][64] is through Company Policies for the important issues of Safety, Quality,

# The Railway Consultancy

The Railway Consultancy provides consultancy services, both nationally and internationally, in the
fields of railway planning, operations, economics, management, strategy and training. Our [areas of
expertise][54] cover both operational and demand planning, and work is carried out for a range of
clients, both in the UK and overseas.

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

On other pages you can find details of our experience gained across a wide range of [rail planning
projects][55], some of them using our in-house [GCOST™][56] and [Trakattk™][57] models.

[Crystal Palace]

We have worked for many train operators, including Southern. Pictured here are two Southern trains
passing underneath our previous office at Crystal Palace Station.

The Railway Consultancy is involved in activities across the major fields of commercial and
operational planning for railways, including metro, suburban, inter-city passenger, and freight.
Projects we have worked are organised under the following headings:
* [Feasibility Studies][58]
* [Commercial Planning][59]
* [Operational Planning][60]
* [Management & Strategy][61]
* [Audit & Assessment][62]
* [Analysis, Research & Training][63]

Already delivered and in service:
* Liverpool South Parkway Station
* Class 455 redesign
* Revised timetable allowances to improve punctuality on SWR, Southern, LNER and in Norway
* HS2 service specification improved to benefit Stoke-on-Trent

[The Railway Consultancy]

Our [ethos][64] is through Company Policies for the important issues of Safety, Quality,
Environment, Charity Support, Recruitment and Training.

    ### [Corrective, Preventive and Predictive maintenance for railway applications][27]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][28] - January 7, 2017 [1][29]
    Railway maintenance is defined as the process of preserving a working condition of a railway
    equipment, along the track or related to rolling stocks, but there are actually different
    approach to mantain a railway asset or service..
    [News][30]
    
    ### [Introduction to CBTC system description][31]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][32] - June 14, 2016 [2][33]
    With CBTC, moving blocks introduce to the concept of contiguous track, because the railway is
    represented as a single contiguous block, rather than a set of adjacent blocks. This means that
    the safe separation behind the preceding train is dynamically calculated based on the maximum
    operating speeds, braking curves and locations of the trains on the alignment. Also, in this way
    the capacity of the railway is extremely increased.
    [News][34]
    
    ### [Conventional vs CABS vs CBTC railway signalling & their impact to capacity][35]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][36] - March 8, 2016 [1][37]
    In railway signalling, capacity can be defined as the maximum number of trains that can pass a
    given location during a given time period at a specified level of reliability.
    [News][38]
    
    ### [Formal methods in railway signalling systems][39]
    
    - February 29, 2016 [1][40]
    Strict safety requirements regulate the development of railway signalling and train control
    systems, covered by the CENELEC (European Committee for Electro-technical Standardization) EN
    5012x rail standards

## Unequalled service experiencee

Sediver offers innovative high-quality toughened glass insulators designed to perform under all
kinds of environmental conditions.

Our outstanding products performance and reliability come from our unique technical expertise gained
through extensive and continuous R&D investments in design, manufacturing and testing.

With more than 95 years of successful experience in insulations and 75 years dedicated to toughened
glass insulators (with over 650+ million of insulators in service worldwide), Sediver is the proven
world expert in transmission insulator technology.

Always on the lookout for the latest advances and continuous technological improvements, Sediver

kinds of environmental conditions.

Our outstanding products performance and reliability come from our unique technical expertise gained
through extensive and continuous R&D investments in design, manufacturing and testing.

With more than 95 years of successful experience in insulations and 75 years dedicated to toughened
glass insulators (with over 650+ million of insulators in service worldwide), Sediver is the proven
world expert in transmission insulator technology.

# Shipbuilding

The shipbuilding industry is a highly complex and technology-intensive sector. The SINCHOLD flexible
track fixing system can optimally meet the diverse and dynamic production demands of modern
shipyards, significantly enhancing the efficiency and safety of material handling, component
assembly, and ship commissioning processes.

][22]
[

### Port and Terminal

As critical hubs of maritime transportation, ports and terminals handle massive cargo
loading/unloading and transfer operations. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can adapt to various
complex terminal layouts and loading/unloading processes, enabling fast and accurate cargo handling.
Additionally, by integrating with automated equipment, it facilitates automated loading and
unloading operations, reducing manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.

][23]
[
****

### Railway

SINCHOLD Flexible Track Fastening System is an innovative rail transit solution that integrates
advanced materials science and engineering technologies. Featuring a unique flexible structural
design, the system ensures essential rigidity while providing controlled elastic deformation
capability. The SINCHOLD design not only enhances track adaptability and durability but also
significantly improves the smoothness and safety of high-speed train operations. By effectively
absorbing vibrations and dynamic loads, it reduces wear on both rails and rolling stock, delivering
superior performance in demanding railway environments. 

][24]
[

### metallurgy

In the electrometallurgy sectors, there is a growing demand for material handling, production line
automation, and operations in extreme environments. Conventional rail systems often struggle to meet
these complex and variable production requirements. In response, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System has emerged as an ideal solution, offering high flexibility, exceptional strength, precision,
and efficiency.

][25]
[

### Aerospace

In the aerospace field, flexible rail systems are primarily used in the manufacturing and assembly
processes of aircraft. These systems utilize specialized flexible rails and vacuum suction cups to
enable stable and precise movement of equipment over the workpiece. The system is highly adaptable
to surfaces with different curvatures, allowing it to process fuselages of varying diameters and
different types of components, such as fuselages and wings. Additionally, the flexible rail system
is easy to operate, convenient to move between workstations, and can be shared across different
aircraft models.

][26]
[

### coking

During the raw material preparation stage in coking plants, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can be
used for coal handling. Due to its high flexibility and strong adaptability, the flexible rail
system enables efficient coal transportation in complex site environments. This reduces the labor
intensity of manual handling and improves operational efficiency.

][27]
[

### Mining

Coal mining often faces complex and variable geological conditions. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System can be adjusted in layout and shape as needed to adapt to different coal seam occurrences
(variations) and mining requirements. This adaptability helps reduce equipment damage and safety
hazards during the mining process.

][28]
[

### Heavy Industry Manufacturing

The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System is suitable for various heavy industry manufacturing sectors,
including automotive manufacturing, precision machinery, new energy, new materials, logistics, and
warehousing, capable of meeting the material handling needs across different industries.

][29]
[

### Automated Warehousing

The application of the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System in automated warehousing is both innovative and
efficient, combining the advantages of automation, intelligence, and flexibility to bring
significant improvements to warehouse management. Specific applications include: Intelligent
Shelving Systems, Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Systems, Sorting and Packaging Systems.

][30]
[

### Municipal Works

In sports venues, sliding roof systems are a common feature used to regulate the internal
temperature and lighting of the facility. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can provide stable and
smooth track support for sliding roofs, ensuring that the roof moves smoothly along the
predetermined trajectory.

][31]

# Shipbuilding

The shipbuilding industry is a highly complex and technology-intensive sector. The SINCHOLD flexible
track fixing system can optimally meet the diverse and dynamic production demands of modern
shipyards, significantly enhancing the efficiency and safety of material handling, component
assembly, and ship commissioning processes.

][22]
[

### Port and Terminal

As critical hubs of maritime transportation, ports and terminals handle massive cargo
loading/unloading and transfer operations. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can adapt to various
complex terminal layouts and loading/unloading processes, enabling fast and accurate cargo handling.
Additionally, by integrating with automated equipment, it facilitates automated loading and
unloading operations, reducing manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.

][23]
[
****

### Railway

SINCHOLD Flexible Track Fastening System is an innovative rail transit solution that integrates
advanced materials science and engineering technologies. Featuring a unique flexible structural
design, the system ensures essential rigidity while providing controlled elastic deformation
capability. The SINCHOLD design not only enhances track adaptability and durability but also
significantly improves the smoothness and safety of high-speed train operations. By effectively
absorbing vibrations and dynamic loads, it reduces wear on both rails and rolling stock, delivering
superior performance in demanding railway environments. 

][24]
[

### metallurgy

In the electrometallurgy sectors, there is a growing demand for material handling, production line
automation, and operations in extreme environments. Conventional rail systems often struggle to meet
these complex and variable production requirements. In response, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System has emerged as an ideal solution, offering high flexibility, exceptional strength, precision,
and efficiency.

][25]
[

### Aerospace

In the aerospace field, flexible rail systems are primarily used in the manufacturing and assembly
processes of aircraft. These systems utilize specialized flexible rails and vacuum suction cups to
enable stable and precise movement of equipment over the workpiece. The system is highly adaptable
to surfaces with different curvatures, allowing it to process fuselages of varying diameters and
different types of components, such as fuselages and wings. Additionally, the flexible rail system
is easy to operate, convenient to move between workstations, and can be shared across different
aircraft models.

][26]
[

### coking

During the raw material preparation stage in coking plants, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can be
used for coal handling. Due to its high flexibility and strong adaptability, the flexible rail
system enables efficient coal transportation in complex site environments. This reduces the labor
intensity of manual handling and improves operational efficiency.

][27]
[

### Mining

Coal mining often faces complex and variable geological conditions. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System can be adjusted in layout and shape as needed to adapt to different coal seam occurrences
(variations) and mining requirements. This adaptability helps reduce equipment damage and safety
hazards during the mining process.

][28]
[

### Heavy Industry Manufacturing

The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System is suitable for various heavy industry manufacturing sectors,
including automotive manufacturing, precision machinery, new energy, new materials, logistics, and
warehousing, capable of meeting the material handling needs across different industries.

][29]
[

### Automated Warehousing

The application of the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System in automated warehousing is both innovative and
efficient, combining the advantages of automation, intelligence, and flexibility to bring
significant improvements to warehouse management. Specific applications include: Intelligent
Shelving Systems, Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Systems, Sorting and Packaging Systems.

][30]
[

### Municipal Works

In sports venues, sliding roof systems are a common feature used to regulate the internal
temperature and lighting of the facility. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can provide stable and
smooth track support for sliding roofs, ensuring that the roof moves smoothly along the
predetermined trajectory.

][31]

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

[Dinghan Germany - Ihr Partner für Leistungselektronik von Schienenfahrzeugen]



[ mehr » ][28]





Unternehmen

SMART Railway – dieser Name steht für jahrzehntelange Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet hocheffizienter
Bordnetzumrichter für den Schienenverkehr. Die Geschichte des heute zur Dinghan Group gehörenden
Unternehmens weist eine kontinuierliche Entwicklung zuverlässiger und auf die Anforderungen der
Bahntechnik zugeschnittener Produkte auf. Seit mehr als 30 Jahren entwickelt und fertigt das in
Kassel ansässige Unternehmen leistungselektronische Lösungen.



[ mehr » ][29]





Wir als Arbeitgeber

Unsere Ideen fahren durch die Welt: Mehr als 10.000 Schienenfahrzeuge fahren bereits mit Systemen
der SMART Railway Technology GmbH, dem weltweiten Technologieführer und größten Hersteller für
Bordnetzumrichter. Mit Leidenschaft, Begeisterung und Visionskraft entwickeln wir anspruchsvolle
Leistungselektronik für den globalen Schienenverkehr. Als erfolgreiches Tochterunternehmen eines
großen internationalen Konzerns bieten wir unseren mehr als 160 Mitarbeitern jede Menge
Gestaltungsfreiraum und beste Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem interkulturellen und
partnerschaftlichen Umfeld. Gemeinsam bewegen wir viel und verändern den Markt – in einer Branche,
die nach vorne schaut.

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

[Dinghan Germany - Ihr Partner für Leistungselektronik von Schienenfahrzeugen]



[ mehr » ][28]





Unternehmen

SMART Railway – dieser Name steht für jahrzehntelange Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet hocheffizienter
Bordnetzumrichter für den Schienenverkehr. Die Geschichte des heute zur Dinghan Group gehörenden
Unternehmens weist eine kontinuierliche Entwicklung zuverlässiger und auf die Anforderungen der
Bahntechnik zugeschnittener Produkte auf. Seit mehr als 30 Jahren entwickelt und fertigt das in
Kassel ansässige Unternehmen leistungselektronische Lösungen.



[ mehr » ][29]





Wir als Arbeitgeber

Unsere Ideen fahren durch die Welt: Mehr als 10.000 Schienenfahrzeuge fahren bereits mit Systemen
der SMART Railway Technology GmbH, dem weltweiten Technologieführer und größten Hersteller für
Bordnetzumrichter. Mit Leidenschaft, Begeisterung und Visionskraft entwickeln wir anspruchsvolle
Leistungselektronik für den globalen Schienenverkehr. Als erfolgreiches Tochterunternehmen eines
großen internationalen Konzerns bieten wir unseren mehr als 160 Mitarbeitern jede Menge
Gestaltungsfreiraum und beste Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem interkulturellen und
partnerschaftlichen Umfeld. Gemeinsam bewegen wir viel und verändern den Markt – in einer Branche,
die nach vorne schaut.

# SRT Smart Railway Technology

**SRT operates on the global rolling stock market for railway infrastructure construction and
maintenance.**

We offer integrated solutions and handle the whole production cycle in-house: from **design and
construction** to **sale **and **rental**, including **maintenance** and **after-sales service**.
Thanks to constant investment in research and innovation, we guarantee our customers
high-performance products that meet the industry’s many and varied needs, helping to improve the
efficiency and safety of railway works to deliver sustainable mobility, with a constant commitment
to excellence in operation.

## Hybrid and electric vehicles for sustainability in the railway industry

With regard to sustainability, SRT invests in the development of solutions to reduce the railway
industry’s environmental impact. [**Colmar electric shunters**][85] and the** hybrid DHS ****wagon**
are fundamental in this transformation, combining excellent performance with an uncompromising focus
on the environment. Colmar shunters offer low running and maintenance costs with superior
performance and lower noise than Diesel locomotives. With its ability for **zero-emissions**
operation, the hybrid DHS wagon is ideal for jobs in sensitive areas where reducing emissions and
noise is crucial.

## Hybrid and electric vehicles for sustainability in the railway industry

With regard to sustainability, SRT invests in the development of solutions to reduce the railway
industry’s environmental impact. [**Colmar electric shunters**][85] and the** hybrid DHS ****wagon**
are fundamental in this transformation, combining excellent performance with an uncompromising focus
on the environment. Colmar shunters offer low running and maintenance costs with superior
performance and lower noise than Diesel locomotives. With its ability for **zero-emissions**
operation, the hybrid DHS wagon is ideal for jobs in sensitive areas where reducing emissions and
noise is crucial.

## [ChatGPT Gets a Health Hub][13]

[Wren Calloway][14]·The Daily

OpenAI is abandoning low-stakes text generation for the highest-liability sector on earth. If they
pull this off without a privacy scandal, they just built an unassailable data moat.

ChatGPT has officially rolled out its Health Hub, establishing a direct pipeline into the most
sensitive personal data available. The new functionality enables users to directly connect their
Apple Health accounts and integrate their medical records into the AI assistant's interface.

[ChatGPT][15]

## Our 6-Step Repair Process

Engineered for speed, precision, and complete transparency — from the moment your equipment arrives
to the day it ships back, repaired and warranted.

STEP 01

### Send Your Equipment

Ship your faulty industrial electronics to our Vadodara facility via any reputable courier, or drop
it off in person. We provide packing guidance to keep fragile equipment safe.

Ship from anywhere in IndiaReputed courier partnersSecure packaging guidance

STEP 02

### Free Diagnostic Evaluation*

Our certified engineers perform a thorough component-level fault analysis using oscilloscopes,
component testers, and OEM documentation. *Conditions apply.

Fault reportRoot-cause analysisComponent-level diagnosis
02
STEP 03

### Transparent Quote

Receive a clear repair quote with genuine part numbers and guaranteed turnaround time. No hidden
charges — ever.

Fixed-price quoteParts listTurnaround guarantee
03
STEP 04

### Expert Component-Level Repair

Our 180+ certified engineers repair at component level — replacing only failed parts (IGBTs,
capacitors, gate drivers, optocouplers) using genuine OEM-grade components.

OEM-grade partsCertified engineersComponent-level precision
04
STEP 05

### Full-Load Testing & QA

Every repaired unit undergoes rigorous full-load testing on our dedicated test rigs under actual
operating conditions. We run it hot until we're 100% satisfied.

Full-load test rigsOperating-condition simulationQA sign-off

## Tragen’s Distinctive Value

### 현장에서 세계로

트라젠은 한국에서 검증된 철도 시스템과 스마트 유지보수 역량을
**세계 시장에 확산시키는 글로벌 허브 역할**을 합니다.

### 세계로 향하는 철도 전문가 육성

실전 중심의 교육과 글로벌 네트워크를 기반으로
**지속 가능한 철도 미래를 이끌 전문가를 배출**합니다.

### AI 기반 철도 운영 매칭

AI와 IoT 기술을 접목하여 운영·정비 자원을 효율적으로
매칭하고 **철도 안전 확보 및 운영** 신뢰성을 높입니다.

### 해외 철도 프로젝트 파트너

국제 개발 협력(ODA)과 해외 운영사와의 공동 추진으로,
**철도 인프라 구축부터 차량·부품 조달, 운영 컨설팅까지** 모든 단계를 아우릅니다.

### 세계와 연결되는 철도 협력망

주요 철도 운영사·제조사와의 협력으로 **기술, 부품, 시스템,
운영 노하우를 연결하는 글로벌 솔루션 허브** 역할을 수행합니다.

## Our Partners

트라젠은 세계 철도 전문가 및 기업과의 협력 네트워크를 통해

## 개인정보처리방침
* ### 제1조 (개인정보 수집에 대한 동의)
  
  ㈜트라젠 이용자들이 회사의 개인정보취급방침 또는 이용약관의 내용에 대하여 “동의”버튼을 클릭하면
  개인정보 수집에 대해 동의한 것으로 봅니다.
* ### 제2조 (개인정보 수집항목)
  
  온라인 문의를 통한 상담을 위해 처리하는 개인정보 항목은 아래와 같습니다.
  수집항목: 이름, 전화번호, 이메일
* ### 제3조 (개인정보의 이용목적)
  
  회사는 이용자의 사전 동의 없이는 이용자의 개인정보를 공개하지 않으며, 원활한 고객상담, 각종
  서비스의 제공을 위해 아래와 같이 개인정보를 수집하고 있습니다. 모든 정보는 상기 목적에 필요한 용도
  이외로는 사용되지 않으며, 수집 정보의 범위나 사용 목적, 용도가 변경될 시에는 반드시 사전 동의를
  구할 것입니다.
  
  성명: 상담에 따른 본인 확인
  전화번호: 상담 및 이벤트 관련 고지사항 전달, 새로운 서비스 및 정보 제공(DM, SMS, 이메일 등)
  이용자는 개인정보 수집/이용에 대한 동의를 거부할 수 있습니다.
  다만, 동의를 거부하는 경우 온라인 문의를 통한 상담은 불가하며 서비스 이용 및 혜택 제공에 제한을
  받을 수 있습니다.
* ### 제4조 (개인정보의 보유 및 이용기간)
  
  원칙적으로 개인정보 수집 및 이용목적이 달성된 후에는 해당 정보를 지체 없이 파기합니다. 관계법령의
  규정에 의하여 보존할 필요가 있는 경우 회사는 법령에서 정한 일정한 기간 동안 정보를 보관합니다.
  
  계약 또는 청약철회 등에 관한 기록: 5년 (전자상거래 등에서의 소비자보호법)
  소비자의 불만 또는 분쟁처리에 관한 기록: 3년 (전자상거래 등에서의 소비자보호법)
  신용정보의 수집/처리 및 이용 등에 관한 기록: 3년 (신용정보의 이용 및 보호법)
  
  종이에 출력된 개인정보는 분쇄기로 분쇄하거나 소각을 통해 파기합니다.
  전자적 파일 형태로 저장된 개인정보는 복구 불가능한 기술적 방법을 사용하여 삭제합니다.

## Tragen’s Distinctive Value

### 현장에서 세계로

트라젠은 한국에서 검증된 철도 시스템과 스마트 유지보수 역량을
**세계 시장에 확산시키는 글로벌 허브 역할**을 합니다.

### 세계로 향하는 철도 전문가 육성

실전 중심의 교육과 글로벌 네트워크를 기반으로
**지속 가능한 철도 미래를 이끌 전문가를 배출**합니다.

### AI 기반 철도 운영 매칭

AI와 IoT 기술을 접목하여 운영·정비 자원을 효율적으로
매칭하고 **철도 안전 확보 및 운영** 신뢰성을 높입니다.

### 해외 철도 프로젝트 파트너

국제 개발 협력(ODA)과 해외 운영사와의 공동 추진으로,
**철도 인프라 구축부터 차량·부품 조달, 운영 컨설팅까지** 모든 단계를 아우릅니다.

### 세계와 연결되는 철도 협력망

주요 철도 운영사·제조사와의 협력으로 **기술, 부품, 시스템,
운영 노하우를 연결하는 글로벌 솔루션 허브** 역할을 수행합니다.

## Our Business Portfolio

Transmission Lines Substations Solar EPC Railways Civil Poles & Lighting

### Transmission Lines

Our Transmission Lines expertise includes design, engineering, manufacturing (of towers, monopoles
and conductors), procurement, construction and commisioning of Transmission lines up to 1200kV on a
turn key basis. We have a footprint in more than 60 countries.

[ Know More ][199]

### Substations

We have executed various AIS and GIS substations on turnkey EPC basis in India and overseas. Our
capabilites include construction of susbstations upto **765 kV** through our expert internal teams.

[ Know More ][200]

### Solar EPC

As a specialised globally operating EPC Company we also provide holistic solutions for Solar EPC
including Solar farms, BESS, Pooling substations and grid connectivity.

[ Know More ][201]

In the railways business, we provide comprehensive solutions including overhead electrification, S&T
systems, earthworks, track laying and other composite works.

## How Where Is My Train Works - Your Complete Railway Companion

Where Is My Train is an online tool that lets you track your live train status without any complex
process. This tracker shows you exactly where the train is on the map, how much distance it has
covered, expected delays, and even platform numbers — all in one place. Our intelligent search
system connects you to real-time data from Indian Railways, covering over 12,000 trains across
8,000+ railway stations. Simply enter your source and destination stations using either names or
codes, and our algorithm shows available trains with complete schedules, running days, and class
availability.

Ever asked yourself, **Where is my train right now?** Whether you're planning a journey, tracking a
loved one's travel, or waiting to board at the next stop, knowing your train's exact location is
crucial. That's where [WhereIsMyTrain.org.in][4] comes in — a simple yet powerful platform to check
live train running status in real-time.

### Why Passengers Live Train Status Love It?

The success of "Where Is My Train" lies in its simplicity and reliability. Unlike some apps that are
cluttered with advertisements and unnecessary features, this one focuses on solving the real
problem: helping passengers know where their train is.

For office-goers commuting daily, it saves time by letting them leave home only when the train is
near. For families traveling long distances, it reduces anxiety about delays and platform changes.
For tourists exploring India, it provides confidence in navigating an unfamiliar transport system.

### The Larger Impact of Train Running Status

Beyond convenience, apps like "Where Is My Train" also contribute to the larger ecosystem:
* **Reducing overcrowding at stations:** When passengers know exactly when to expect their train,
  they spend less time waiting on platforms.
* **Improving punctuality awareness:** Delays are unavoidable, but having accurate information
  ensures passengers can adjust their schedules rather than being left in the dark.
* **Promoting digital inclusion:** Since it works offline and supports multiple languages, even
  first-time smartphone users in small towns can benefit.

### Future of Train Travel in India

While "Where Is My Train" has been revolutionary, the journey doesn't stop here. Indian Railways has
been investing in digitization and modernization, such as:
* Installing real-time GPS trackers on trains.
* Upgrading stations with better digital displays.
* Introducing smart ticketing systems to reduce queues.
* Using artificial intelligence for predictive delay management.

In the coming years, we can expect even more seamless integration between train tracking apps and
official railway systems, creating an ecosystem where passengers have all the information they need
at their fingertips.

### How to Use the Train Tracker Tool?
1. Visit [where is my train][5]
2. Enter your train number or train name
3. Hit the Search button
4. Instantly view your train's live location, upcoming stations, and other travel insights

No app installation required, and it works smoothly on mobile too!

### Who Can Use the Train Running Status Tool?

This service is built for everyone — whether you're a regular train commuter, a first-time traveler,
or someone picking up a friend or family member.
* Daily office-goers using trains
* Tourists planning routes
* People receiving guests at stations
* Families tracking long-distance journeys
* Students and parents during admission season

### Benefits of Using WhereIsMyTrain
* Avoid unnecessary platform waiting
* Plan better with real-time train data
* Improve your journey experience
* Reliable and fast — without any downloads
* 100% free for all users

### Final Thoughts

The simple question—"Where is my train?"—may sound trivial, but for millions of Indians, it carries
weight. It's the difference between making it to a family wedding on time, catching an important job
interview, or reaching home safely after a long day.

Thanks to technology and apps like Where Is My Train, travelers no longer need to rely on guesswork
or incomplete information. Instead, they can travel with confidence, knowing that help is just a tap
away on their smartphones.

Train journeys will always remain an integral part of Indian life. And with tools like this, they're
becoming smarter, smoother, and more stress-free than ever before.

### FAQs

#### Q. Is this tool official?

This tool uses data from IRCTC/NTES APIs but is independently designed to give you a fast, ad-free
experience.

#### Q. Can I track all Indian trains here?

Yes! You can search for any passenger, express, or superfast train using its number or name.

#### Q. Is this service free?

Yes, this tool is completely free and accessible to everyone.

## How Where Is My Train Works - Your Complete Railway Companion

Where Is My Train is an online tool that lets you track your live train status without any complex
process. This tracker shows you exactly where the train is on the map, how much distance it has
covered, expected delays, and even platform numbers — all in one place. Our intelligent search
system connects you to real-time data from Indian Railways, covering over 12,000 trains across
8,000+ railway stations. Simply enter your source and destination stations using either names or
codes, and our algorithm shows available trains with complete schedules, running days, and class
availability.

Ever asked yourself, **Where is my train right now?** Whether you're planning a journey, tracking a
loved one's travel, or waiting to board at the next stop, knowing your train's exact location is
crucial. That's where [WhereIsMyTrain.org.in][4] comes in — a simple yet powerful platform to check
live train running status in real-time.
